definitions: A valve in the carburetor of an internal combustion engine that restricts air flow.
An act or sound of choking.
An induction coil used to block high-frequency alternating current while letting direct current pass.
The narrowed part of the bore of a shotgun barrel.
examples: Pull the choke to start the cold engine.
He gave a small choke of surprise.
The circuit requires a high-frequency choke.
